pages.text: Craft the station with one heart, two iron ingots, three slimeballs and three stone bricks. It binds two ordinary Transport Slimes or two ordinary Combat Slimes. You must be the primary owner of both. Other types and upper variants cannot be bound.

Before recovery, clear effects, fire, freezing and absorption, and let both companions regain full air. Put their items in the two slots, review their records and choose Bind. Gear, cargo, identities and invested stats remain. Neither recovery nor unbinding restores health or stamina.

Both colony types have cord-linked bodies and shared orders, cargo and vitals. Transport members divide jobs; Combat members use their own gear and can join a fight with a critical leap. Unbinding transfers remaining effects to member one. Creative point edits change only the shared balance.

Unused points start at the mean rounded down. One point raises the chosen stat for each uncapped member; capped members stay unchanged. Both capped means no cost. Growth is half rate while any stat used by the role can still upgrade both members; otherwise normal rate. The point-cost formula is unchanged.

Recover the colony, place it alone in the station and choose Unbind. Two safe spaces are needed. Both return in Wait with remaining traits and a copy of the shared points. Each resumes its own pre-binding growth tier plus points earned while bound. Remaining activity progress scales to each requirement. Cancelled spawns keep the colony; pending results remain recoverable.

A needs 224 activity for its next point; B needs 288. From zero progress, the colony needs 288 credited activity to earn one shared point. Spending it upgrades both if uncapped. After unbinding, A needs 288; B needs 352. The 64-activity gap is not refunded as points. An upgrade still costs one shared point.
